```sql
WITH scoped_tickets AS (
    -- Scope the tickets rows
    SELECT
        id,
        requester_id,
        agent_id,
        closed_at,
        channel,
        csat,
        tags,
        TO_DATE(closed_at) AS closed_at_date
    FROM tickets
    WHERE requester_id <= 22
),
combined_details AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.requester_id,
        s.agent_id,
        s.closed_at,
        s.channel,
        s.csat,
        s.tags,
        s.closed_at_date,
        su.agent_name,
        su.hired_on AS agent_hired_on
    FROM scoped_tickets s
    JOIN support_agents su ON su.id = s.agent_id
    WHERE su.hired_on BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-09' AND DATE '2025-02-27'
),
enriched_agent AS (
    -- Attach agent attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.agent_id,
        s.closed_at,
        s.channel,
        s.tags,
        s.agent_hired_on,
        su.agent_name AS agent_agent_name,
        su.hired_on AS agent_hired_on_2
    FROM combined_details s
    LEFT JOIN support_agents su ON su.id = s.agent_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    agent_id,
    closed_at,
    channel,
    agent_hired_on,
    agent_agent_name,
    agent_hired_on_2,
    INITCAP(TRIM(agent_agent_name)) AS agent_agent_name_clean
FROM enriched_agent
ORDER BY id DESC NULLS FIRST, closed_at DESC NULLS FIRST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

scoped_tickets = (
    df_tickets
    .filter(F.col("requester_id") <= 22)
    .select(
        "id",
        "requester_id",
        "agent_id",
        "closed_at",
        "channel",
        "csat",
        "tags",
        F.to_date(F.col("closed_at")).alias("closed_at_date"),
    )
)

combined_details = (
    scoped_tickets.alias("s")
    .join(df_support_agents.alias("su"), F.col("su.id") == F.col("s.agent_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("su.hired_on").between(F.lit("2024-07-09").cast("date"), F.lit("2025-02-27").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.requester_id",
        "s.agent_id",
        "s.closed_at",
        "s.channel",
        "s.csat",
        "s.tags",
        "s.closed_at_date",
        "su.agent_name",
        F.col("su.hired_on").alias("agent_hired_on"),
    )
)

enriched_agent = (
    combined_details.alias("s")
    .join(df_support_agents.alias("su"), F.col("su.id") == F.col("s.agent_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.agent_id",
        "s.closed_at",
        "s.channel",
        "s.tags",
        "s.agent_hired_on",
        F.col("su.agent_name").alias("agent_agent_name"),
        F.col("su.hired_on").alias("agent_hired_on_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_agent
    .select(
        "id",
        "agent_id",
        "closed_at",
        "channel",
        "agent_hired_on",
        "agent_agent_name",
        "agent_hired_on_2",
        F.initcap(F.trim(F.col("agent_agent_name"))).alias("agent_agent_name_clean"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc_nulls_first(), F.col("closed_at").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

```sql
WITH recent_events AS (
    -- Scope the ticket_events rows
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_type,
        actor,
        COALESCE(actor, 'UNKNOWN') AS actor_or_unknown
    FROM ticket_events
    WHERE event_type <> 'replied'
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event_at per actor
    SELECT *, LAG(event_at) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id) AS prev_event_at
    FROM recent_events
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 90 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_at IS NULL OR event_at > prev_event_at + INTERVAL 90 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
actor_stats AS (
    -- Max new_session_flag per actor
    SELECT actor, MAX(new_session_flag) AS max_new_session_flag
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY actor
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_new_session_flag,
        ROUND(s.new_session_flag - g.max_new_session_flag, 2) AS new_session_flag_minus_max
    FROM sessionized s
    JOIN actor_stats g ON g.actor = s.actor
    WHERE s.new_session_flag = g.max_new_session_flag
)
SELECT
    id,
    ticket_id,
    actor,
    actor_or_unknown,
    prev_event_at,
    new_session_flag,
    session_no,
    max_new_session_flag,
    ROUND(max_new_session_flag * 1.1, 2) AS max_new_session_flag_adj
FROM compared
ORDER BY actor DESC, id
LIMIT 20
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent_events = (
    df_ticket_events
    .filter(F.col("event_type") != "replied")
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        F.coalesce(F.col("actor"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("actor_or_unknown"),
    )
)

with_prev = recent_events.withColumn("prev_event_at", F.lag("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("actor").orderBy("event_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_event_at").isNull() | (F.col("event_at") > F.col("prev_event_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("actor").orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

actor_stats = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("actor")
    .agg(F.max("new_session_flag").alias("max_new_session_flag"))
)

compared = (
    sessionized.alias("s")
    .join(actor_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.actor") == F.col("s.actor"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.new_session_flag") == F.col("g.max_new_session_flag"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_new_session_flag",
        F.round(F.col("s.new_session_flag") - F.col("g.max_new_session_flag"), 2).alias("new_session_flag_minus_max"),
    )
)

result = (
    compared
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "actor",
        "actor_or_unknown",
        "prev_event_at",
        "new_session_flag",
        "session_no",
        "max_new_session_flag",
        F.round(F.col("max_new_session_flag") * 1.1, 2).alias("max_new_session_flag_adj"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("actor").desc(), "id")
    .limit(20)
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

enriched = (
    df_suppliers
    .withColumn("prev_rating", F.lag("rating").over(Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy("rating", "id")))
    .withColumn("next_rating", F.lead("rating").over(Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy("rating", "id")))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy("rating", "id")))
    .withColumn("country_min_rating", F.min("rating").over(Window.partitionBy("country", "city")))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy("country")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "New York", F.col("prev_rating"))).alias("new_york_total_prev_rating"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("country") == "JP", F.col("country_min_rating"))).alias("jp_total_country_min_rating"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("cnt") > 1)
)
```

```sql
WITH with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR started_at > LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id) + INTERVAL 60 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM sessions
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM with_gaps
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        session_no
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, device ORDER BY session_no, id) AS rn
        FROM islands
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events x
            WHERE x.session_id = s.id
              AND x.event_time < s.started_at
        )
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events ch
            WHERE ch.session_id = s.id
              AND ch.event_time >= s.started_at
        )
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), started_at) AS days_since_started_at,
        INITCAP(TRIM(device)) AS device_title
    FROM not_flagged
    WHERE started_at >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2023-08-30 12:00:00')
      AND browser IS NOT NULL
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        session_no,
        device_title,
        days_since_started_at - session_no AS days_since_started_at_minus_session_no
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE browser IS NOT NULL
      AND days_since_started_at BETWEEN 21 AND 35
)
SELECT
    id,
    device,
    browser,
    started_at,
    session_no,
    device_title
FROM filtered;
```

```python
)

islands = with_gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

deduped = (
    islands
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "device").orderBy("session_no", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("id", "device", "browser", "started_at", "session_no")

kept = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("x"), (F.col("x.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.event_time") < F.col("s.started_at")), "left_anti")

    .filter((F.col("started_at") >= F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2023-08-30 12:00:00"))) & F.col("browser").isNotNull())

filtered = (
```

```sql
WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        CONCAT(carrier, ', ', status) AS carrier_status,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'N/A') AS resolved_carrier
    FROM shipments
    WHERE shipped_date >= DATE '2023-07-27'
      AND cost <= 54
),
valid_shipments AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        carrier_status,
        COALESCE(cost, 0) AS cost_filled,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_carrier_2
    FROM valid
    WHERE delivered_date >= DATE '2023-10-03'
      AND order_id IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(delivered_date), carrier ORDER BY cost_filled, id) AS cost_filled_bucket,
        SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, carrier ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_cost,
        FIRST_VALUE(cost, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_cost,
        AVG(cost_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS cost_filled_avg_6_prior,
        AVG(cost) OVER (ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS cost_avg_6_prior
    FROM valid_shipments
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.order_id,
        src.carrier,
        src.delivered_date,
        src.cumulative_cost,
        src.cost_filled_avg_6_prior,
        src.cost_avg_6_prior,
        d.channel,
        d.status,
        d.amount
    FROM enriched src
    LEFT JOIN orders d
        ON src.order_id = d.id
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY cost_filled_avg_6_prior DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS dedup_rank
    FROM joined
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
totals AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN cost_avg_6_prior >= 73 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS cost_avg_6_prior_tier,
        CASE WHEN cost_filled_avg_6_prior >= 71 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS cost_filled_avg_6_prior_tier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'partner' THEN cumulative_cost ELSE 0 END) AS partner_cumulative_cost,
        AVG(cost_avg_6_prior) AS avg_cost_avg_6_prior,
        ROUND(SUM(amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN carrier = 'Kerry' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS amount_per_kerry,
        COUNT_IF(channel = 'partner') AS partner_events
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN cost_avg_6_prior >= 73 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN cost_filled_avg_6_prior >= 71 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
    HAVING partner_cumulative_cost > 0
)
SELECT
    cost_avg_6_prior_tier,
    cost_filled_avg_6_prior_tier,
    partner_cumulative_cost,
    avg_cost_avg_6_prior,
    amount_per_kerry,
    partner_events
FROM totals
ORDER BY partner_events DESC NULLS FIRST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("shipped_date") >= F.lit("2023-07-27").cast("date")) & (F.col("cost") <= 54))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        F.concat("carrier", F.lit(", "), "status").alias("carrier_status"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_carrier"),
    )
)

valid_shipments = (
    valid
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") >= F.lit("2023-10-03").cast("date")) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "carrier_status",
        F.coalesce("cost", F.lit(0)).alias("cost_filled"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("resolved_carrier_2"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid_shipments
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("delivered_date"), "carrier").orderBy("cost_filled", "id")).alias("cost_filled_bucket"),
        F.sum("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id", "carrier").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_cost"),
        F.first("cost", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_cost"),
        F.avg("cost_filled").over(Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("cost_filled_avg_6_prior"),
        F.avg("cost").over(Window.orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("cost_avg_6_prior"),
    )
)

joined = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.order_id",
        "src.carrier",
        "src.delivered_date",
        "src.cumulative_cost",
        "src.cost_filled_avg_6_prior",
        "src.cost_avg_6_prior",
        F.col("d.channel"),
        F.col("d.status"),
        F.col("d.amount"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    joined
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("cost_filled_avg_6_prior").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

totals = (
    ranked
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("cost_avg_6_prior") >= 73, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("cost_avg_6_prior_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("cost_filled_avg_6_prior") >= 71, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("cost_filled_avg_6_prior_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "partner", F.col("cumulative_cost")).otherwise(0)).alias("partner_cumulative_cost"),
        F.avg("cost_avg_6_prior").alias("avg_cost_avg_6_prior"),
        F.round(F.sum("amount") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "Kerry", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("amount_per_kerry"),
        F.count_if(F.col("channel") == "partner").alias("partner_events"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("partner_cumulative_cost") > 0)
)

result = (
    totals
```

```python
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("voltage").alias("max_reading_voltage"),
        F.round(F.avg("kwh"), 2).alias("avg_reading_kwh"),
        F.count("*").alias("reading_count"),
    )
)

profiled = (
    recent.alias("s")
    .join(reading_stats.alias("m"), F.col("m.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "m.max_reading_voltage",
        "m.avg_reading_kwh",
        F.coalesce(F.col("m.reading_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("reading_count"),
    )
)

labeled = (
    profiled
    .filter(F.col("max_reading_voltage") >= 224.0)
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        "max_reading_voltage",
        "avg_reading_kwh",
        "reading_count",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("read_at")).alias("days_since_read_at"),
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("quality")), " ", "_")).alias("quality_slug"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    labeled
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        "avg_reading_kwh",
        "reading_count",
        "days_since_read_at",
        "quality_slug",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("quality"))).alias("quality_len"),
    )
)

quality_stats = (
    tagged
    .groupBy("quality")
    .agg(F.max("quality_len").alias("max_quality_len"))
)

outliers = (
    tagged.alias("s")
    .join(quality_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.quality") == F.col("s.quality"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.quality_len") == F.col("g.max_quality_len"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_quality_len",
        F.round(F.col("s.quality_len") - F.col("g.max_quality_len"), 2).alias("quality_len_minus_max"),
    )
)

site_id_stats = (
    outliers
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(F.avg("days_since_read_at").alias("avg_days_since_read_at"))
)

compared = (
    outliers.alias("s")
    .join(site_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.days_since_read_at") > F.col("g.avg_days_since_read_at"))
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev

    FROM flagged

        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY actor, burst_id
)

    actor,
    burst_id,
    session_end,
    event_count,
```

```python
    .withColumn("last_known_cost_share", F.last("cost_share", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("cost_avg_3_prior", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

)

        "cost_bucket",
        "cost_share",
        "running_cost",
        "cost_avg_3_prior_avg_2_prior",
        "last_known_cost_share",
        F.max("event_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("status")).alias("status_max_event_seq"),
        F.lag("cost_avg_3_prior", 1).over(Window.orderBy("running_cost", "id")).alias("prev_cost_avg_3_prior"),
```

```sql
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL

eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products x
            WHERE x.supplier_id = s.id
              AND x.supplier_id IN (20, 31)
        )
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.supplier_name,
        s.country,
        latest.product_launch_date
    FROM eligible s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.launch_date AS product_launch_date
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.cost DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY product_launch_date ASC, id ASC) AS row_num
        FROM latest_match
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
eligible_suppliers AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1

),
not_flagged AS (

    WHERE EXISTS (

              AND c.launch_date >= s.product_launch_date
        )
)

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', product_launch_date), country ORDER BY product_launch_date DESC, id ASC) AS seq_no
FROM not_flagged;
```

```python
    df_students

        "enrolled_on",

        F.when(F.col("cohort").isin("C2024", "C2021"), "group_a").when(F.col("cohort") == "C2022", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("cohort_group"),
        F.when(F.col("gpa") >= 3.2, "HIGH").when(F.col("gpa") >= 2.7, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("gpa_tier"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("major"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("major_or_unknown"),
    )
)

summary = (
    scoped
    .groupBy("gpa_tier")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("major") != "Biz", 1)).alias("n_major_biz"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("major")).alias("major_list"),
    )
)

exploded = (
    summary
    .select(
        "gpa_tier",
        "row_count",

w_gpa_tier_major_list_item_pos = Window.partitionBy("gpa_tier", "major_list_item_pos").orderBy("n_major_biz", "gpa_tier", "major_list_item_pos")
ranked = (

        F.size(F.collect_set("major_list_item").over(w_major_list_item_pos_gpa_tier)).alias("distinct_major_list_item_in_major_list_item_pos_"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w_gpa_tier_major_list_item_pos).alias("n_major_biz_quintile"),
```

```sql
        r.site_id,
```

```sql
    JOIN tariff_windows tw
      ON tw.tariff = st.tariff

        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at), zone ORDER BY kwh), 3) AS kwh_percent_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(energy_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at), zone ORDER BY kwh, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_energy_cost,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_read_at_month_zone_by_kwh, 3) AS kwh_percent_rank_2
    FROM in_window
    WINDOW w_read_at_month_zone_by_kwh AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at), zone ORDER BY kwh, id)
),
summarized_rows AS (

        (SELECT ROUND(AVG(m.kwh), 2) FROM meter_readings m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS avg_reading_kwh
    FROM metrics s
```

```python
    )
)

w_listener_id = Window.partitionBy("listener_id")
w_all_by_ms_played = Window.orderBy(F.col("ms_played").desc(), "id")
sequenced = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "track_id",
        "played_at",
        "ms_played",
        "device",

        F.sum("ms_played").over(w_listener_id).alias("listener_id_sum_ms_played"),

        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("ms_played").desc(), "id")).alias("ms_played_dense_rank"),

        F.lead("played_at").over(w_all_by_ms_played).alias("next_played_at"),
        F.min("ms_played").over(Window.partitionBy("track_id", "source_group")).alias("track_id_source_group_min_ms_played"),
        F.nth_value("played_at", 2).over(Window.orderBy("played_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_played_at"),

        F.sum(F.when(F.col("device").isin("phone", "desktop"), F.col("distinct_device_in_listener_id")).otherwise(0)).alias("distinct_device_in_listener_id_device_in_phone_d"),
        F.round(F.sum("listener_id_min_ms_played") / F.nullif(F.sum("distinct_device_in_listener_id"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("listener_id_min_ms_played_to_distinct_device_in_"),
        F.max("ms_played_dense_rank").alias("max_ms_played_dense_rank_check"),
```

```python
    .select("id", "coupon_codes", F.explode("attributes").alias("attr_key", "value"))

    exploded
    .select("id", "attr_key", "value", F.explode("coupon_codes").alias("value_2"))
)

remaining_keys = (
    flattened
    .select("id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_carts
        .filter(F.col("customer_id").isin([21, 35, 36]))
        .select("id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    flattened
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("attr_key").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("value_2_upper", F.upper("value_2"))
)

cleaned = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("attr_key") != "gift")
    .withColumn("value_2_filled", F.coalesce("value_2", F.lit("N/A")))
)

kept_keys = (

    .select("id")
    .intersectAll(

        .filter(F.to_date("created_at") >= "2025-09-01")

    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")

    .subtract(

)
```

```sql
    FROM sessionized
```

```sql
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(burst_id, 0.5) AS median_burst_id,
```

```sql
    FROM flagged

        burst_id,
        MIN(played_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(played_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY listener_id, burst_id
)
-- Final projection

    listener_id,

    session_start,
    session_end,
    events,
    ROUND(duration_min / NULLIF(events, 0), 3) AS duration_min_per_events
```

```sql
    FROM sessionized

),
```

```sql
        t.csat AS ticket_csat,
```

```sql
joined AS (
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        grade_status,
        enrolled_at,
        CASE WHEN term IN ('2025T1', '2025T2') THEN 'group_a' WHEN term = '2024T1' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS term_group,
        CASE WHEN score >= 57.6 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN score >= 11.3 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS score_tier
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE course_id <= 5
),
windowed AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(score) OVER (PARTITION BY grade_status) AS grade_status_max_score,
        ROUND(score / NULLIF(SUM(score) OVER (PARTITION BY grade_status), 0), 4) AS score_share_of_grade_status
    FROM prepared
),
course_id_stats AS (
    -- Median grade_status_max_score per course_id
    SELECT course_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(grade_status_max_score, 0.5) AS median_grade_status_max_score
    FROM windowed
    GROUP BY course_id
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_grade_status_max_score,
        ROUND(s.grade_status_max_score - g.median_grade_status_max_score, 2) AS grade_status_max_score_minus_median
    FROM windowed s
    JOIN course_id_stats g ON g.course_id = s.course_id
    WHERE s.grade_status_max_score >= g.median_grade_status_max_score
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM above_average
    WHERE score_share_of_grade_status > (SELECT AVG(score_share_of_grade_status) FROM above_average)
),
tagged AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        term,
        score,
        grade_status,
        enrolled_at,
        term_group,
        score_tier,
        grade_status_max_score,
        score_share_of_grade_status,
        median_grade_status_max_score,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', enrolled_at) AS enrolled_at_month
    FROM screened
),
labeled AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        score,
        term_group,
        score_tier,
        GREATEST(grade_status_max_score, score) AS greatest_grade_status_max_score_score
    FROM tagged
    WHERE median_grade_status_max_score < 800.0
),
screened_2 AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM labeled
    WHERE score > (SELECT AVG(score) FROM labeled)
)

FROM (

    FROM screened_2
) src

) unp
```

```sql
    FROM sessionized

        session_end,
```

```sql
        SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration_min,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_meter_readings.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_meter_readings.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.site_id") == F.col("a.site_id"))
        & (F.col("b.read_at") < F.col("a.read_at"))
        & (F.col("b.read_at") >= F.col("a.read_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.site_id", "a.read_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_1d"),
        F.sum("b.voltage").alias("prior_voltage_1d"),
    )
)

w_all_by_prior_rows_1d = Window.orderBy("prior_rows_1d", "id")
with_windows = (
    in_window
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(3).over(w_all_by_prior_rows_1d).alias("prior_rows_1d_tercile"),
        F.round(F.col("prior_rows_1d") / F.nullif(F.sum("prior_rows_1d").over(Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_1d", F.year("read_at"))), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("prior_rows_1d_share_of_prior_rows_1d_read_at_yea"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("read_at") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("read_at").over(w_all_by_prior_rows_1d))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_read_at"),
    )
)

site_id_stats = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("prior_voltage_1d", 0.5).alias("median_prior_voltage_1d"))
)

vs_group = (
    with_windows.alias("s")
    .join(site_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.prior_voltage_1d") >= F.col("g.median_prior_voltage_1d"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.median_prior_voltage_1d",
        F.round(F.col("s.prior_voltage_1d") - F.col("g.median_prior_voltage_1d"), 2).alias("prior_voltage_1d_minus_median"),
    )
)

sequenced = (
    vs_group
    .select(
        "*",
```

```sql
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_part AS adjusted_units_dense_rank
    FROM base
```

```python
w_recent = Window.orderBy("quantity", "id")
w_part = Window.orderBy("next_quantity", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
revenue_by_product_id = df_store_sales.groupBy("product_id").agg(F.avg("revenue").alias("avg_store_sale_revenue"))

base = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("unit_price_rounded", F.round("unit_price", 1))
)

latest = (
    base
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

with_dims = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "left")
    .select("s.id", "s.order_id", "s.product_id", "s.quantity", F.col("o.status"))
)

with_windows = (
    with_dims
    .filter(F.col("status").isin(["CANCELLED", "RETURNED", "SHIPPED"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "status",
        F.lead("quantity", 1).over(w_recent).alias("next_quantity"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w_recent).alias("quantity_bucket"),
    )
)

    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "status",
        "quantity_bucket",
        F.avg("next_quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("next_quantity", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("next_quantity_avg_3"),
        F.lag("quantity_bucket", 2, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("next_quantity", "id")).alias("prev_quantity_bucket"),
        F.avg("next_quantity").over(w_part).alias("next_quantity_avg_2_prior"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("o.order_date"),
        F.col("o.status").alias("order_status"),
        F.col("o.channel"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
```

```python
w_running = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("element").asc_nulls_first())

flattened = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "currency", F.explode_outer("tier_limits").alias("element"))
)

scored = (

    .withColumn("element_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w_running))
    .withColumn("element_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("element").asc_nulls_first())))
    .withColumn("currency_count_element", F.count("element").over(Window.partitionBy("currency")))
    .withColumn("element_rank", F.rank().over(w_running))
)

scored_price_tiers = scored.select("*", F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("element_cume_dist").asc_nulls_first())).alias("element_cume_dist_cume_dist"))

with_windows = (
    scored_price_tiers
    .filter(F.col("element_rank") != 6)
    .withColumn("element_cume_dist_cume_dist_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("element_cume_dist_cume_dist").desc())))
    .withColumn("element_rank_2", F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("element").desc())))
)

scored_price_tiers_2 = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "element_percent_rank",
        "currency_count_element",
        "element_cume_dist_cume_dist",
        "element_cume_dist_cume_dist_percent_rank",
        "element_rank_2",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("element_cume_dist_cume_dist_percent_rank").desc_nulls_first())).alias("element_cume_dist_cume_dist_percent_rank_dense_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("element_rank_2") / F.sum("element_rank_2").over(Window.partitionBy("currency"))), 4).alias("element_rank_2_share"),
        F.stddev_samp("element_rank").over(Window.partitionBy("currency")).alias("currency_stddev_samp_element_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("element").desc_nulls_first())).alias("element_dense_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("element_rank") / F.sum("element_rank").over(Window.partitionBy("currency"))), 4).alias("element_rank_share"),
    )

filtered = (
```
